turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good morning, Mrs. Wilson. What brings you in today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I’ve had pressure in my chest since yesterday. I thought it was just indigestion.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe what it feels like? Is it sharp, burning, or more like heaviness?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: More like someone is sitting on my chest. It reminds me of what my husband experienced before his heart attack. I’m frightened something similar might happen to me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I understand why that would worry you. Does it get worse when you climb stairs, and do you get short of breath?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes. Yesterday, I had to stop halfway up the stairs, and I was a little short of breath.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint, dizzy, or lightheaded with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little dizzy this morning, but I didn’t faint.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have high blood pressure, high cholesterol, or diabetes? Any heart procedures before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take tablets for my blood pressure. No, I don’t think I’ve had any heart procedures. I’ve never had heart surgery.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Thank you. Your record mentions a heart procedure a few years ago, so we’ll need to verify those details.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don’t remember that. My daughter usually keeps track of those things.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Given your symptoms, we need an ECG and an urgent assessment at the emergency department. I’ll arrange for the team to help with your transfer.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I’m sorry, I didn’t catch the last part. What did you say about where I’m going?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I’m going to contact the team now so they can get everything ready.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Will my daughter be able to come with me? I get confused when there’s too much information.
